measured_now: 当該文は見当たらない。該当する原文は Experiment 2 Results の『Notably, of the integration facts that were neither self-generated nor selected in forced-choice at Session 1 (n = 21), the new knowledge was subsequently self-derived 67% of the time. This increase was evidenced in both open-ended and forced-choice modes, constituting 29% and 38% of the trials, respectively.』。単位は子どもではなく21試行で、67% のうち38ポイントは三択の強制選択（偶然水準は約33%）。リマインダーのない実験1でも初回失敗試行の50%（自由再生6%・強制選択44%）が1週間後に成功している（Table 3）。
